title: The Jacobian is a Local Warp
tagline: Near a point, a nonlinear map acts like its Jacobian — a circle becomes an ellipse
summary: A nonlinear map F from R2 to R2 bends space, but zoom in and the bending straightens into a linear stretch-and-rotate given by the Jacobian. Side-by-side input and output panels show a small circle around a draggable base point carried through the true map, next to the ellipse the Jacobian predicts. Shrink the radius and the two coincide; grow it and a gap opens. A live 2x2 Jacobian, its determinant as an area-scale factor, and the columns drawn as arrows tie the picture to singular values, exploding/vanishing gradients, and the chain rule as a matrix product.
highlights: Drag a base point and watch a small input circle map to an ellipse in output space through a true nonlinear map.
Overlay the Jacobian's predicted ellipse and see it match the true image ever more closely as the radius shrinks.
Read a live 2x2 Jacobian with its columns drawn as arrows — the images of the x and y directions.
Watch det J as the local area-scaling factor, and a gap readout quantifying where linearization breaks down.
Connects circle-to-ellipse to singular values, vanishing/exploding gradients, and the chain rule as a product of Jacobians.
